title: kaxxiinak gubal radde gadda
intro: ucsub soltam foocal gaddi roortih kaxxam fidnih too dubuk quukah maftacitte butta maqar le canka. ku dariifal, xongoloola rammitleela kee kassit esserta, takkay immay kaxxiina gadda geyak fayya inta. maca akkeleeh acwa aqayyaare takke wak kee kaxxiina xaloot muhrissa wak?
clues: Anu Muusa ummattak suge, uxih keenil taturte.
Anu gadda yomcowwe kaxxam mango too fakeenit keenih quuka maqar le marih dokon.
Anu inni ummatta fayisseh sugtem ruffa edde axce waanam kee ta baadal liyo saami habbaale kal akeera gorrisaanam.
Anu liyoomuh yoh tomcowweemih taagah liyoh an ixxiga dubuk yoh tomcowwem yot celta.
Anu inni ummattah foocal bilqah soolo abeeh, baadal tan mano faxaanam anu liyoh an innal niyaatan.
Anu inni sigo lih ardi yanxuqeh sugeeh, num yoo catam maduudaay, anu inni catam maduuda.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
